'''March 2001 Melbourne tournament (11 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 11 March 2001. Robbo won it. It is known from Ronnie Wilcox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1905">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-bastardized-melbourne-11-3-01d1905/ bastardized-melbourne-11-3-01], DeckTech (Ronnie "AD-fig" Wilcox, 17 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-bastardized-melbourne-11-3-01d1905/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' Robbo
